row.notes: Drops one reference a VM handle holds on node (refcount u16 at node+0x24); at 1 left it destroys the node (vtable +8) and frees it through the registry's allocator. Callers first unlink the handle {node,next,prev} from the node's holder list at node+0x28 (0x141b6ba20 does it for each handle of a tile set). | (Allocator **a, Resource *r), a null r returns at once (0x1442b3d76). Before the lock dec of the u16 at r+0x24 (0x1442b3dee) it releases r's children synchronously, through 0x1442b3e30 (child map, count at +0x80) or 0x1442b4120 (child vector +0x40..+0x48) as vtable +0x28 picks, when the count equals the children plus 2 (0x1442b3dc2, 0x1442b3de1); that step is skipped when the qword at +0x30 is set, vtable +0x20 returns true or the count is 1, and the helpers call Vm_Release_Node again for r and for each child, so a hook here is re-entered for the same node. When the count re-read after the dec is 1 (0x1442b3df7) it calls the dtor (vtable +8, edx 0) and tail-jumps to the allocator's vtable +0x38 with (alloc, r) (0x1442b3e1e). Callers: census steam 0x42b3d70, among them game mode parse, the session HUD and the season UI. | #589 proposed the name Ne_Resource_Release | #589 proposed the subsystem core
